description: Re-speaks a recording in another voice: same words, timing and emotion. Returns the audio job id. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card with the result: say one line, never its `url` (no card? give it); no `show_generation`. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), never timers or background shells. COST: 1 token per started minute of the part changed (1 s to 5 minutes), measured by the server. A longer recording needs start_seconds and end_seconds to pick at most 5 minutes of it. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_cost`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).

end_seconds.description: Where the part to change ends, in seconds of the source; at most 300 s after start_seconds. Omit for the end of the file.

source_audio.description: An audio generation on this account (its id or url) or an MP3, WAV or M4A uploaded on it (`upload_media`). No external urls.

start_seconds.description: Where the part to change starts, in seconds of the source. Omit for the top.

voice.description: An ElevenLabs library voice id from `list_voices` with `usable_for=audio`.

name: change_voice
title: Change the voice in a speech recording
